main_body: desert mud-brick house with flat roof terrace
top_band: light sandy tan roof terrace with parapet wall, rug and hatch, rows 0-31
evidence: Rows 0-31 show the flat roof surface from above (lighter sandy tone, inner parapet shadow at rows 3-5, rug and ladder hatch on the roof, front parapet highlight at rows 28-31). Rows 32-33 form a dark overhang/eave shadow above the darker terracotta front wall (rows 32-63) which has beam ends, an inset arched wooden door, and an inset lattice window.

style.evidence: While the candidate uses dark brown material outlines and some scattered noise dots on the plaster/mud walls, its surface detailing is significantly flatter and simpler than the Beodeul references. The rug on the roof has a large solid red fill (~11x7 px of a single colour), the wooden door panels have flat vertical bands without grain, and the wall speckle lacks the rich multi-step sculptural shading and high per-tile colour density of the reference houses.
